facts.business: SEAMEC Limited provides offshore support services through its fleet of Diving Support Vessels (DSVs), an Offshore Support Vessel (OSV), and an Accommodation Barge, and also operates bulk carriers through its subsidiaries.
key_risks: Carrying value, useful life of fleet and fleet equipment, amortization of dry dock cost and cost of modification
facts.related_party_note: Revenue related to consortium member deducted from charter hire income (Tonage: Rs 772.59 lakhs, Non-Tonnage: Rs 611.41 lakhs for FY2026); Interest on loan to subsidiaries Rs 313.80 lakhs; For transaction with related parties refer note 44 for disclosure as per Ind AS 115 revenue from contract with customers
